title: Box Office: ‘Avatar 3’ Dominates Christmas With $88M for $760M Global Crown, Timothée Chalamet Strikes Again
summary: As a troubled box office year comes to a close, at least Christmas revenue hit a post-pandemic best thanks to an eclectic mix of films that offered something for everyone, led by 'Marty Supreme' and including 'Anaconda,' 'The Housemaid' and faith-based 'David.'
